job.job_description:
Python Developer (FastAPI -Immediate Joiner Only)




Job Title: Python Developer

Required Skills & Experience:

Strong experience in Python development.
Hands-on experience with FastAPI for building RESTful APIs and microservices.
Good knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, etc.).
Experience with API integration, authentication (JWT/OAuth), and asynchronous programming.
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker.
Understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is an advantage.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Python and FastAPI.
Build and optimize REST APIs and microservices.
Integrate third-party services and databases.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
Perform unit testing, debugging, and code reviews.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

Must Have: Proven hands-on experience with FastAPI
Strong Python programming skills
Experience developing and consuming REST APIs

Experience: 3+ Years (or as required)
Location: Chennai
